A travertine stair with lit treads and a glass balustrade leads upstairs.

Newly built 3-bedroom family villa on a quiet street in Sanur, a 10-minute walk from the beach. Private pool with a shallow area for children, tropical garden with sun loungers, and three en-suite bedrooms with A/C, blackout curtains and garden views. Open-plan living room with a dining area, fully equipped kitchen, 300 Mbps fibre Wi-Fi and a work-friendly desk. Housekeeping 3x a week, pool and garden care included. Free private parking with automatic gates; staff meet every guest in person.

Villa Papat stands down a quiet lane in Umalas, between Canggu and Seminyak: four bedrooms in separate pavilions around a lawn and a long private pool. Each bedroom has its own bathroom, several of them open-air with a free-standing tub among the bamboo. The open living room with its deep blue sofa looks straight onto the garden, and the kitchen with a concrete island and bar seating sits alongside the dining table. Fast Wi-Fi, washing machine, safe, free parking in a gated community. Sleeps 10.

Premier Umalas 17 is a two-bedroom home with a private pool in the quiet lanes of Umalas, the residential strip of small roads and rice fields between Canggu and Seminyak. Both bedrooms are en-suite and have their own balconies. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps and the house has two separate workspaces, which makes it work for a couple staying for months as much as for a short holiday. Fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning and a Smart TV. Berawa and Canggu beaches are about 10 minutes away by bike. Sleeps 4.

A nine-bedroom villa at the end of a lane in Pererenan, ten minutes on foot from the beach. Two floors of white rooms under timber beams, each bedroom with its own bathroom. The living room, dining room and kitchen open onto a long private pool, and the lawn behind the house runs down to a mountain river. There is a home cinema, a piano, a BBQ area and a hammock under the palms. Fast Wi-Fi, washer and dryer, free parking. Sleeps up to 18 — made for two families travelling together, weddings and company retreats.

A ready three-bedroom villa in the quiet lanes of Umalas, built in 2023 and rented out since February 2024 — the buyer takes over a working property, not a construction site. 158 m² of house on a 146 m² plot: three bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and desks, an enclosed air-conditioned living room and kitchen, and glass doors onto a private 4.4 × 2.25 m pool and a planted courtyard. Over the twelve months to July 2026 the villa returned $2,600 a month net to the owners after running costs and the management fee.

A two-bedroom townhouse villa in central Sanur, built in 2025 over two floors and already in our rental programme. 105 m² of house on a 100 m² plot: an enclosed living room, dining room and kitchen downstairs, two bedrooms upstairs each with its own bathroom, a guest bathroom below, and a 2.5 × 4 m private pool with the house looking onto it. Sold furnished and ready to move into, with fibre internet, three air conditioners and open parking. A compact house for one or two people, or a small rental unit in an area that books all year.

Two-storey 341 m² villa built in 2023, a 2–5 minute walk from Berawa Beach in Canggu. Six bedrooms, each with a king bed, a TV and its own en-suite bathroom, plus a separate guest toilet. Open-plan living room with a Smart TV and fully equipped kitchen opening onto a large private pool through full-height glass doors; a wide first-floor balcony overlooks the garden. Fast Wi-Fi, a safe in every room and housekeeping three times a week are included. Sleeps up to 12 — suited to large families, groups of friends, weddings and company retreats.

Serenity 9 is a secluded three-bedroom pool villa in the gated Serenity complex on Jl. Kesari II in Sanur, about 500 m from the beach — a seven-minute walk. Each bedroom has its own bathroom and air conditioning. There is a lounge with a Smart TV, a fully equipped kitchen with a microwave and coffee, a dining nook, and a private pool with a sunbathing area surrounded by tropical greenery. The Vastu-based layout keeps the rooms bright through the day. Fast internet, free parking, 24/7 security in the complex and cleaning included. Sleeps 6.

Premier Umalas 16 is a three-bedroom townhouse in the quiet lanes of Umalas, between Canggu and Seminyak, finished in dark stone and warm wood. Each bedroom has its own en-suite bathroom and a desk by the window; the enclosed living room and the kitchen with its island are air-conditioned, and glass doors open onto a private pool and a small planted courtyard. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps, and with three separate workspaces the house is set up for people staying for months as much as for a holiday. Washing machine, safe and iron are on site. Sleeps 6.

A one-bedroom teak villa in a quiet Ungasan compound, with a private pool, a lawn and a bright open-plan interior. Bedroom, living area and the kitchen with its breakfast bar all sit under one pitched teak roof; the bathroom opens onto greenery and has a free-standing tub and a rain shower. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps and there is a workspace and an in-room safe. Housekeeping three times a week, scooter parking and self check-in are included, and the beaches of the Bukit are about ten minutes away. Sleeps 2 — made for couples, solo travellers and long stays.

Serenity 6.2 is a two-bedroom villa in the gated Serenity complex on Jl. Kesari II in Sanur, about 500 m from the beach — a seven-minute walk. It has a separate entrance and its own kitchen; both bedrooms are en-suite and air-conditioned, and the Vastu-based layout keeps the interior bright. The pool and the small tropical courtyard garden are shared with one neighbouring villa — sociable rather than fully private, and worth knowing before you book. Fast Wi-Fi, a dedicated workspace, free parking and cleaning during the stay. Suits couples and small groups. Sleeps 4.

A two-bedroom villa in Ungasan built from natural teak, with its own pool, a lawn and two covered verandas. Both bedrooms have extra-wide two-metre beds, air conditioning and their own bathroom; the enclosed living room and fully equipped kitchen are air-conditioned as well, and the dining table looks straight out at the water. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps, so the villa suits remote work as much as a family holiday. Self check-in with a code lock, free scooter parking and housekeeping three times a week are included, and the beaches of the Bukit are about ten minutes away. Sleeps 4.

Serenity 10 is a furnished two-bedroom apartment on the second floor of the gated Serenity complex on Jl. Kesari II in Sanur, about 500 m from the beach — a seven-minute walk. It comes with a private terrace looking over the complex grounds, two bedrooms sharing one bathroom, a fully equipped kitchen and air conditioning throughout, under a Vastu layout that keeps the rooms bright. This is an apartment, not a villa: there is no pool of its own. Fast Wi-Fi, a dedicated workspace, free parking and 24/7 security in the complex. Suits couples and solo travellers who want somewhere ready to move into. Sleeps 4.

The fourth villa in the Mudra compound in Ungasan, next door to the other three and built the same way — from natural teak, under a pitched roof, with its own pool and lawn. A king bed looks out on the garden through glass doors; the enclosed living room with a Smart TV and a kitchenette sits beside it, and the bathroom opens onto greenery with a free-standing tub and a rain shower. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps, there is a workspace and a wide covered terrace. Housekeeping three times a week, scooter parking and self check-in are included, and the beaches of the Bukit are about ten minutes away. Sleeps 2 — made for couples, solo travellers and long stays.

Serenity 3 is a three-bedroom villa in the gated Serenity complex on Jl. Kesari II in Sanur, about 500 m from the beach — a seven-minute walk. All three bedrooms are en-suite and air-conditioned, with large windows onto the garden. The living room has a Smart TV, the kitchen is fully equipped, and glass doors open onto a private plunge pool in a planted courtyard with a sun terrace. The layout follows Vastu principles, which here means bright rooms through the day. Fast Wi-Fi and a workspace with natural light, free parking, 24/7 security in the complex, housekeeping and pool and garden maintenance included. Suits families, couples and people working remotely. Sleeps 6.

Serenity 6.1 is a two-bedroom villa in the gated Serenity complex on Jl. Kesari II in Sanur, about 500 m from the beach — a seven-minute walk. It has its own separate entrance, so you never cross paths with neighbours coming or going, and its own separate kitchen. Both bedrooms are en-suite and air-conditioned, and the interior is modern and bright under a Vastu layout. One thing to know before booking: the pool area and the small garden are shared with one neighbouring villa. If you want a pool entirely to yourself, look at Serenity 3 or Serenity 9 instead. Fast Wi-Fi, a dedicated workspace, free parking and cleaning during the stay. Suits couples and small groups. Sleeps 4.

A one-bedroom villa in Ungasan on the Bukit peninsula, built almost entirely from natural teak and wrapped in tropical planting. Step out of the bedroom and you are at a private pool set in a garden; the air-conditioned living area with a Smart TV runs into a kitchen with a bar counter, and the bathroom has its own garden outlook and a free-standing tub. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps and there is a desk by the window, so the villa works for remote work as much as for a slow holiday. Scooter parking, housekeeping three times a week and a laundry pick-up service are included; the beaches of the south coast are around ten minutes away. Sleeps 2 — made for couples, solo travellers and long stays.

Two-storey 235 m² villa on a quiet lane in south Sanur, a short walk from local cafés and about a kilometre from Mertasari Beach. Four bedrooms — the master on the ground floor with a pool view, three more upstairs — each with a king bed and its own en-suite bathroom, plus a separate guest toilet. The enclosed living and kitchen area is air-conditioned, with a large sofa, Smart TV and a dining table for eight, and opens through sliding glass doors onto a 35 m² private pool with four sunbeds and a garden. Fast Wi-Fi, a dedicated workspace, filtered drinking water, private parking and housekeeping three times a week are included. Sleeps up to 8 — suited to families and to two or three families travelling together.

A three-bedroom villa on Jalan Danau Tamblingan — the street that runs the length of Sanur — three minutes on foot from the ocean and the beachfront promenade. Two floors and 200 m² of house on a 300 m² plot, renovated top to bottom in 2026 and sold fully furnished. The ground floor is modern and open: a living room and a dining table under lit ceilings, timber doors onto the pool terrace, and a closed kitchen in white and walnut with quartz worktops, an induction hob and an oven. Behind it sit a guest toilet with the laundry, a walk-in wardrobe and one more room the owners left empty — an office, a gym or a fourth bedroom, with its own glazed doors onto a planted courtyard. A travertine stair with lit treads and a glass balustrade leads upstairs. Above, the house keeps its Balinese character: open rafters under alang-alang thatch, stone-clad walls behind the beds, travertine floors and carved timber balconies over the garden. Three bedrooms share two marble bathrooms with double vanities and walk-in showers, one of them with a free-standing tub at the window. Outside, a nine-metre pool in green stone mosaic runs the length of the lawn under old frangipani trees, with sun loungers on the terrace and a lounge corner at the far end. The villa stands in a managed complex with its own security; the ocean shows from the upper floor and the mountains inland on a clear day.
